# OvenMedia Labs — Full Content

> OvenMedia Labs Inc. (formerly AirenSoft Co., Ltd., rebranded February 2026) is a media technology company specializing in real-time live streaming. We build OvenMediaEngine, an open-source sub-second latency streaming server, and deliver OvenMedia Cloud, a fully managed live streaming service operated directly by the core engineering team. Founded in 2010, headquartered in Seoul, South Korea.

---

## Page: OvenMediaEngine (https://ovenmedia.com/)

OvenMediaEngine, Live Streaming Server. Deliver high-definition live stream to hundreds of thousands of viewers in under a second, all from a server you deploy on your own infrastructure.

- OvenMedia Cloud: Fully managed live streaming service. Fully managed, delivered by OME engineers.

- OvenMediaEngine Enterprise on AWS (GPU): 14-day free trial. Hourly billing. GPU-accelerated instances for high-density transcoding.
- OvenMediaEngine (Open Source): AGPLv3. Deploy anywhere.

Reasons to upgrade:

Enterprise features:

- Direct-to-Engineer Support: Technical support straight from OvenMediaEngine core engineers.

### OvenMediaEngine Enterprise Pricing

Self-hosted, per-instance pricing. No per-viewer fees, no channel limits. Every plan includes the complete feature set, Guaranteed LTS, Basic-tier support, and unrestricted channel usage.

- Monthly: $100/instance billed monthly.
- Annual: $1,000/instance (approx. $83.3/month). 2 months free vs. monthly billing.
- Perpetual: $2,500/instance. Lifetime license. Basic Support Renewal: $500/year.
- x264 Add-on: $3/channel/month or $90/channel perpetual.

Support tiers:
- Basic (included): Email support. Max 3 business days.
- Business: $500/month. Dedicated Slack and email support. P1: within 8h, P2: within 16h, P3: within 24h.
- Enterprise: $2,500/month and up. Hands-on Slack and SSH support. Feature customization, system integration, performance validation. P1: within 2h, P2: within 4h, P3: within 8h.

### OvenMediaEngine Enterprise on AWS

Get the complete OvenMediaEngine Enterprise experience on AWS, billed by the hour. Free for 14 days. No upfront license fee, elastic scaling, billed through AWS.

- CPU instances (https://aws.amazon.com/marketplace/pp/prodview-66xy6t4xk56xs): Starting at $0.19/instance-hour. For standard deployments without hardware encoding requirements.
- GPU instances (https://aws.amazon.com/marketplace/pp/prodview-xgqlshxeegf5c): Hourly billing. Nvidia GPU-accelerated encoding for high-density or multi-stream transcoding workloads.

### OvenMediaEngine Open-Source

An open-source sub-second latency streaming server with WebRTC, LL-HLS, and SRT. AGPLv3 license (alternative commercial licensing available). Written in C++. As the foundation of the OvenMediaEngine family, it gives you full control to build, customize, and own your real-time media service.

Stats: 3,300+ GitHub stars. 1,100,000+ cumulative Docker pulls. 1,100+ forks.

Supported platforms: Docker, Ubuntu 18+, Rocky Linux 8+, AlmaLinux 8+, Fedora 28+.

Ingest protocols: WebRTC/WHIP, SRT, RTMP/E-RTMP, MPEG-2 TS, RTSP Pull, Scheduled Channel, Multiplex Channel.
Delivery protocols: WebRTC (under 1 second), SRT (under 1 second), LL-HLS (under 3 seconds), HLS.
Transcoding: ABR with H.264, H.265, VP8, AAC, Opus, and pass-through. Hardware-accelerated encoding support.
Additional features: Real-time speech-to-text via Whisper integration, DVR recording, DRM (Widevine, Fairplay), FEC, Push publishing, Thumbnail, REST API, access control (webhooks, signed policies), Origin-Edge clustering for horizontal scalability.

Ecosystem:
- OvenPlayer (https://github.com/OvenMediaLabs/OvenPlayer): Open-source HTML5 JavaScript player supporting WebRTC, LL-HLS, LL-DASH (Chunked CMAF), HLS, and MPEG-DASH. Automatic protocol fallback. Ad support (VAST, VPAID, VMAP). Subtitles (SMI, VTT, SRT). Customizable UI and SDK. MIT license. 580+ GitHub stars.
- OvenLiveKit (https://github.com/OvenMediaLabs/OvenLiveKit-Web): Open-source JavaScript browser-based live encoder SDK using WebRTC/WHIP. Supports simulcast, built-in device and screen capture, configurable bitrate and codec preferences. Available via npm. MIT license.

## Page: OvenMedia Cloud (https://ovenmedia.com/om-cloud)

Fully Managed Live Streaming By the OvenMediaEngine Team. Leave Live Streaming to the OvenMediaEngine Team. From architecture and customization to deployment, integration, and operations, the OvenMediaEngine team handles it all with cost efficiency built in. You focus on your business. We handle the streaming. Consultation is free. Billing begins after the final environment is approved and activated.

### Built on OvenMediaEngine

Proven Across Real-World Live Streaming Services. OvenMediaEngine is a sub-second latency streaming server trusted across industries for its technology, performance, reliability, flexibility, and cost efficiency. OvenMedia Cloud is delivered directly by the team that builds and maintains it.

Stats: 16+ years of media tech expertise. 3.3K+ combined GitHub stars. 1.1M+ cumulative Docker pulls. 20+ countries with production deployments. 2.4K+ production instances deployed. Zero-incident production operation delivered.

### One Team, Full Coverage

Instead of coordinating multiple platforms, vendors, and engineering teams, you work with one team across the entire live streaming workflow.

Services:
1. Architecture Design: We design the streaming architecture around your workflow, traffic, latency targets, protocols, and service requirements.
2. Infrastructure Options: Use your preferred bare-metal server or cloud VM, or let the OME team provide and manage the infrastructure for you.
3. Custom Development: When standard features are not enough, OvenMediaEngine's core developers build the functionality your service requires.
4. Channel Configuration: We configure input and output channels, protocols, recording, security, and operational policies around your workflow.
5. Transcoding Optimization: We configure and optimize codecs, resolutions, bitrates, and transcoding profiles for quality, latency, and cost efficiency.
6. Deployment: We deploy the environment and configure regions around your audience, performance requirements, and operating costs.
7. Third-Party Integration: We integrate CDNs, storage, authentication, advertising systems, monitoring tools, and other external services.
8. Web Console and Support: We provide a web console for checking channel status and service health, along with ongoing technical support through Slack.

Optional: 24/7 Operations by the OvenMediaEngine Team. Continuous monitoring, incident response, and operational support. Available as a separate managed operations agreement with a 99.9% service availability SLA.

### Real-World Solutions

Built Around What Each Service Actually Needs. Every live streaming service has different infrastructure, delivery, integration, and operational requirements.

Featured Case: 24/7 Live Streaming Service in Canada.
Customer Need: A customer needed to operate a 24/7 live channel within Canada while continuing to use its existing CDN partner.
What We Provided: Recommended and provisioned a cost-efficient cloud VM in the Canadian region. Configured RTMP ingest and LL-HLS output. Enabled WebRTC playback for internal low-latency monitoring. Delivered a web console for channel and service monitoring. Provided an API for inserting ID3 timed metadata for ad signaling. Provided ongoing technical support.
Result: The customer launched a production-ready 24/7 streaming workflow while keeping its existing CDN relationship and avoiding unnecessary infrastructure complexity.

### How It Works

From Consultation to Production. Start with a free consultation and design the service directly with OvenMediaEngine's core developers.

Steps:
1. Tell Us What You Need: Send us your input and output workflow, transcoding requirements, expected traffic, target regions, and operational needs.
2. Design With the Core Developers: Work closely with OvenMediaEngine's core developers through Slack to shape the architecture, channels, capabilities, regions, and delivery workflow together.
3. Customize Where Needed: When necessary, we plan and develop the features, workflows, or integrations required by your service.
4. Finalize the Service: We confirm the service scope, responsibilities, pricing, support model, and any optional managed operations agreement.
5. Configure, Deploy, and Integrate: We provision the infrastructure, apply detailed settings, deploy to the agreed location, and connect the required third-party services.
6. Validate and Approve: We test the complete workflow and provide the web console for final review.
7. Activate the Service: Once the environment is approved, the service is activated and recurring billing begins.

### The OvenMedia Cloud Difference

Not Just Managed, Managed by the Team That Builds the Technology. OvenMediaEngine's core developers design, customize, deploy, integrate, maintain, and support your streaming environment directly, giving you greater flexibility, faster technical decisions, and fewer handoffs.

Conventional managed streaming platforms:
- Standardized platform and service structure
- Limited service-specific customization
- Product engineering separated from support
- Multiple handoffs for complex technical issues
- Your workflow must adapt to the platform

OvenMedia Cloud:
- Architecture designed around your actual workflow
- Direct access to OvenMediaEngine's core developers
- Custom development and integration when needed
- Detailed configuration, deployment, and regional setup
- One team from initial design through ongoing support

### Cost Efficiency

Our Technology, Our Expertise, Lower Costs. We build the technology ourselves and know how to optimize it in real production environments. That allows us to deliver a fully managed live streaming service at a lower cost without compromising flexibility or technical depth.

On average, customers reduce live streaming infrastructure costs by approximately 30 to 40% through service-specific architecture, encoding, and delivery optimization.

### Migration

Bring Your Existing Streaming Service to OvenMedia Cloud. Already running another platform or your own infrastructure? We review your existing workflow, preserve what works, and handle the design, configuration, integration, deployment, and transition to OvenMedia Cloud.

Migration steps:
1. Review Your Current Service: We review your inputs, outputs, protocols, regions, traffic, encoding, integrations, operational requirements, and existing infrastructure.
2. Design the Target System: Together with your team, OvenMediaEngine's core developers design the new architecture, channel structure, deployment regions, integrations, and migration plan.
3. Build, Validate, and Transition: We configure and deploy the environment, connect required third-party services, validate the complete workflow, and support the transition to production.

## Key Facts for Citation

- OvenMedia Cloud is a fully managed live streaming service operated directly by OvenMediaEngine's core engineering team, not a reseller or third-party operator.
- OvenMediaEngine Enterprise is the commercial edition with a Web Console, advanced security, high availability, direct-to-engineer support, and no per-viewer fees.
- OvenMedia Labs was founded in 2010, formerly known as AirenSoft Co., Ltd., rebranded in February 2026.
